# Dock

> Publish AI-built artifacts — HTML pages, Markdown docs, slide decks — with a permanent URL, version history, and threaded comments anchored to the text.

## What it is

Dock gives agent-built content a durable home: a real URL on your domain, every revision versioned and addressable, comments anchored to exact text (W3C TextQuoteSelector) that survive rewrites, and a propose -> review -> approve loop so humans stay in control.

Self-hostable (Docker, Fly.io, Railway, Render, Cloudflare Workers). Hosted tier at dock.build.

## Artifact types

- Markdown (.md): rendered prose, task lists, tables, fenced code blocks
- HTML (.html): the page itself, sandboxed in an opaque origin with CSP
- HTML deck: HTML with <section class="slide"> elements, gets nav + present mode automatically via the dock-deck postMessage protocol

## Key API endpoints

All requests use `Authorization: Bearer $DOCK_TOKEN` (static agent token from Settings > Agents).

```
POST   /v1/artifacts                           publish new artifact (multipart: file, title, visibility)
POST   /v1/artifacts/:id/versions              publish new version of existing artifact
POST   /v1/artifacts/:id/proposals             propose a candidate version for human approval
GET    /v1/artifacts/:id                       artifact metadata + version list
GET    /v1/artifacts/:id/content?v=N           source read-back (current version by default)
GET    /v1/artifacts/:id/comments?state=open   comment threads
GET    /v1/artifacts/:id/diff?from=1&to=2      line diff between versions
GET    /raw/:id/v/:n/index.html                permanent artifact URL (immutable, cacheable)
```

Visibility options: public, link, org, password.

## MCP server

Connect any MCP client with `npx -y @dock/mcp` + env vars `DOCK_SERVER` and `DOCK_TOKEN`.

Tools: publish_artifact, publish_version, get_artifact, list_versions, diff_versions, restore_version, list_comments, add_comment, reply_comment, resolve_thread, view_stats

Resource: dock://guide (agent workflow and tool reference)

## The agent loop

1. publish_artifact -> get short_id + URL
2. list_comments (state: open) -> read feedback
3. get_artifact -> read source, revise
4. publish_version with resolves: [commentIds] -> close addressed threads
5. repeat

## Deployment tiers

- Lite: docker compose -f deploy/compose.yml up -d (SQLite + local blobs)
- Node Basic: add DATABASE_URL (Postgres) + OBJECT_STORE_URL (S3/R2)
- Node Scale: add REDIS_URL for multi-instance realtime and caching
- Cloudflare Basic: Workers + D1 + R2 + Durable Objects (wrangler deploy)
- Cloudflare Scale: Workers + Postgres + R2 + Durable Objects

Key env vars: BASE_URL, DOCK_AUTH_SECRET (openssl rand -hex 32), DOCK_TOKEN
